messages.text: Hi! We are hiring part-time online workers. Earn Rs. 5000 per day from home, no experience needed.
What is the job?
You just rate products on our merchant platform. Each task gives commission.
Ok how do I start
Register at https://star-tasks.example and join our Telegram group for tasks.
To unlock premium tasks you need to top up your task wallet with Rs. 10,000. You get it back with 30% commission.
Congratulations, you completed today's tasks! Your balance is Rs. 48,000.
Great, how do I withdraw?
Before withdrawal you must pay a 15% processing fee to release your earnings.
Can't you deduct it from my balance?
Sorry, system rules. Pay within 2 hours or your account will be frozen.
That doesn't sound right.
Dear applicant, you are selected for a data entry job. Salary Rs. 80,000 monthly.
I didn't apply anywhere, but ok. What's next?
No interview required. Only pay the registration fee of Rs. 3,500 to confirm your slot.
Why is there a fee?
It's for training materials. Limited slots, pay today only.
Send the payment slip to this WhatsApp number 07X-XXX-XXXX.
Hello oyata part time job ekak karanna puluwanda? Gedara indan salli hoyanna puluwan.
Mokakda job eka?
YouTube videos like karanna witharai. Ekak Rs. 150 gewanawa.
Hari, mama kala. Salli awa.
Niyamai! Dan merchant task ekak thiyenawa. Rs. 5000 deposit karanna one, passe Rs. 7500 labenawa.
Deposit karanna one aida?
Hi, I'm Nadee from a travel marketing agency. We pay people to write hotel reviews online.
How much?
Rs. 300 per review, about 30 reviews a day.
Sounds good.
First complete 3 free tasks. Then you reach level 2 where you prepay the booking amount and get it refunded with commission.
Level 2 needs a minimum deposit of Rs. 15,000. Send to the account in the app https://travel-boost.example/app
Machan Dubai hotel job ekak thiyenawa. Salary Rs. 250,000. Interview nathuwa yanna puluwan.
Ane hari, mokakda karanna one?
Visa processing fee eka Rs. 45,000 gewanna one ada ma.
Agreement ekak thiyenawada?
Passe denawa. Dan slip eka WhatsApp karanna, seats limited.
Hmm mama hithanna one.
Hi, this is Kasun from the HR team at Lakview Solutions. Thank you for applying for the Software Engineering Intern role.
Thank you! I'm very interested.
We'd like to schedule a technical interview. Are you available on Tuesday at 10 AM?
Yes, Tuesday works.
Great. You'll receive a calendar invite from our careers page https://careers.lakview.example. Please bring your university ID.
Will do, thanks.
Congratulations! We are pleased to offer you the Junior Accountant position at Ceyfin Pvt Ltd.
Thank you so much! What are the next steps?
The starting salary is Rs. 95,000 per month. Please review and sign the attached contract.
I've signed it.
Thanks. For payroll, please submit your bank account details through the HR portal on your first day.
Understood, see you on Monday.
Hi, we saw your design portfolio. We need a logo for a small bakery brand.
Sure, what's the budget and deadline?
Rs. 20,000, delivered within a week. We pay after final files are delivered.
Sounds fair. I'll send 3 drafts by Thursday.
Perfect. Please send an invoice when done.
Will do.
Hi, me Colombo branch eke part time cashier job ekata oyage CV eka labuna.
Ow, mama interested.
Heta 2.30 ta interview ekata enna puluwanda? Original certificates genna.
Ow puluwan. Kohenda enna one?
Branch eke office ekata enna. Training free, salary masa aga bank ekata danawa.
Hari, thank you.
Hello, thank you for interviewing for the Marketing Executive role at Bluewave Media.
Thank you for the opportunity.
Unfortunately we've decided to move forward with another candidate.
I understand. Could you share any feedback?
Your presentation was strong; we wanted more campaign analytics experience. We'll keep your CV for future roles.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
Hi, call centre agent job eka gena oyata details denna kiyala kiwwa.
Ow, shifts kohomada?
Day and night shifts thiyenawa. Transport allowance company eken denawa.
Training ekata salli gewanna one da?
Nehe, training eka company eken free. Mulin interview ekak thiyenawa.
Hari, interview date eka kiyanna.
